product_overview: iRopit is a Chrome extension that displays an Android phone's notifications, SMS conversations, and call logs in a popup UI by syncing encrypted data via Firebase. It lets users read notifications, view and reply to SMS, inspect call history, select a paired device, and manage authentication and settings from the browser.
core_goals: Provide a fast, real-time view of an Android device's notifications, SMS, and call logs inside a Chrome extension popup.
Allow authenticated users to read and reply to SMS via their paired Android device.
Maintain security by using AES-256 encryption client-side and Firebase Auth for user access control.
Support quick device selection and real-time updates via Firestore onSnapshot listeners.
Offer basic settings (theme, language, privacy) and session management (logout, account deletion).

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate users with Firebase Email/Password and redirect authenticated users to the main popup view.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html#login -> See login form with email and password fields -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Click Login button -> Receive successful auth from Firebase -> Redirect to /popup.html#main -> See main popup with tab navigation

Navigate to /popup.html#login -> See login form with email and password fields -> Enter email address -> Enter incorrect password -> Click Login button -> Receive error from Firebase (invalid credentials) -> See error message on login form -> Remain on /popup.html#login

features.name: Notifications Tab
features.description: Display notifications synced from the paired Android device in real-time, with app icon, title, body and timestamp.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click Notifications tab -> See list of notifications with app icon, title, body, timestamp -> Scroll through notification list -> Receive new notification via Firestore onSnapshot -> See new notification appended to list
Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click Notifications tab -> See empty state when no notifications -> Firestore connection error occurs -> See offline or error indicator and an explanatory message

features.name: SMS Tab - Conversation List
features.description: Show SMS conversations grouped by contact/phone number, with unread badges and sorting by latest message.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click SMS tab -> See list of SMS conversations sorted by latest message -> See unread conversation badges -> Click on a conversation -> Redirect to /popup.html#sms-detail
Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click SMS tab -> See empty state when no conversations -> Firestore permission denied or connection error -> See error message and guidance to reconnect

features.name: SMS Conversation Detail
features.description: View full chat-style message history for a conversation and send replies which are relayed through the paired Android device.
user_flows: Click on a conversation in the SMS list -> Navigate to /popup.html#sms-detail -> See contact name or phone number as header -> See conversation messages in chat bubble format -> Type reply message in input field -> Click Send button -> Post send command to Firestore users/{uid}/devices/{deviceId}/sms -> See sent message added to conversation

Navigate to /popup.html#sms-detail -> Type reply message in input field -> Click Send button -> Firestore send command fails or device offline -> See error toast indicating send failed -> Sent message not appended to conversation

features.name: Calls Tab
features.description: Present call history synced from the Android device including contact name/number, call type, duration and timestamp.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click Calls tab -> See list of calls with contact name, phone number, call type icon, duration, timestamp -> Scroll through calls
Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click Calls tab -> See empty state when no calls -> Firestore connection or permission error occurs -> See error message explaining data is unavailable

features.name: Device Selection
features.description: Allow the user to choose which paired Android device's data (notifications, SMS, calls) is displayed in the extension.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html#main -> See device selector in header -> Click device selector -> See list of paired devices from Firestore users/{uid}/devices onSnapshot -> Select a device from list -> Data (notifications/SMS/calls) refreshes for selected device

Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click device selector -> See list of paired devices -> Select a device that is currently offline -> See offline indicator or 'last seen' timestamp -> Data does not refresh and a warning is shown

features.name: Logout
features.description: Sign the user out of Firebase Auth and return the extension to the unauthenticated login state.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click settings or logout button -> Confirm logout in dialog -> Firebase signOut succeeds -> Redirect to /popup.html#login -> See login form
Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click logout -> Confirm logout -> Firebase signOut fails due to network error -> See error message and remain on /popup.html#main

features.name: Settings & Preferences
features.description: Adjust UI theme and language, view privacy policy, and manage encryption key and account settings from the extension.
user_flows: Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click Settings -> Toggle Dark/Light mode -> See UI update immediately to selected theme -> Change language to Arabic -> UI updates to Arabic and adjusts to RTL if supported -> Click Privacy Policy -> Open privacy policy content

Navigate to /popup.html#main -> Click Settings -> Change language while Firestore sync or remote config unavailable -> Change persists locally but remote sync fails -> See a warning about sync failure

known_limitations.issue: Extension popup requires Firebase authentication - unauthenticated state shows login form only
known_limitations.impact: Most features only testable when logged in with valid Firebase credentials

known_limitations.issue: SMS send functionality requires a connected Android device with the iRopit app installed
known_limitations.impact: Send SMS feature may not work in isolation without real device

known_limitations.issue: Real-time data requires active Firestore connection
